newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas barely traded, prices little changed.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas barely traded, prices little changed.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract was traded only four times on Monday, with a total of 25 lots done, all in the afternoon session.
"It's just a quiet start to the week," a futures broker said, adding that he was not aware of any specific reason why trade had failed to take off.

The disappointing trade followed three busier days at the end of last week, with good activity seen especially on Wednesday and Thursday. But the market started slowly on Monday with no transactions concluded at all in the morning session, and the afternoon was also unusually thin.

By the close June had traded once at 10.05 pence a therm for five lots, down by 0.04 pence from Friday's settlement. November saw three small trades with the last one done at 13.410 pence a therm, up by 0.010 pence a therm from the previous settlement price. No other month saw any deals done.
